facts.fact: Adwave runs TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram from a $30/day minimum.
facts.quote: With Adwave, TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram run from a $30/day minimum, and warranty claims must follow FTC guidance.

facts.fact: Adwave's daily budget ranges from $30 to $10,000.
facts.quote: Adwave’s daily budget runs from $30 to $10,000

facts.fact: Reddit ads on Adwave start at about $35 per day.
facts.quote: From about $35/day

facts.fact: TikTok ads on Adwave are opt-in and start at about $91 per day, with a connected TikTok account.
facts.quote: Opt-in, from about $91/day, with a connected TikTok account

facts.fact: Extra ad creation on Adwave is billed at $0.38 per image.
facts.quote: Extra creation is billed at $0.38 per image

facts.fact: Extra ad creation on Adwave is billed at $6 per social video.
facts.quote: $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot

facts.fact: The Adwave pricing page uses a $75/day planning example, which totals $2,250 over 30 active days.
facts.quote: The Adwave pricing page uses a $75/day planning example, which totals $2,250 over 30 active days.

facts.fact: At the $30 daily minimum, 30 active days comes to $900.
facts.quote: At the $30 minimum, 30 active days comes to $900.

facts.fact: Adwave has no subscription, no contract and no added fee on top of the daily budget.
facts.quote: There is no subscription, no contract and no added fee on top.

facts.fact: On Adwave, card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits have no added fee.
facts.quote: Card deposits carry the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: On Adwave, if the prepaid wallet cannot cover the day's budget, the campaign pauses.
facts.quote: If the wallet can’t cover the day, the campaign pauses.

facts.fact: The Rhode Island Small Business Development Center suggests starting local digital campaigns with $10 to $50 per day.
facts.quote: starting with $10 to $50 per day

facts.fact: Cyncly reports that phone calls fell four times faster than form submissions across its network of more than 2,000 independent flooring retailer websites in Q1 2026 compared with Q1 2025.
facts.quote: phone calls fell four times faster than form submissions

facts.fact: Cyncly's network includes more than 2,000 independent flooring retailer websites.
facts.quote: its network of more than 2,000 independent flooring retailer websites

facts.fact: The FTC's Guides for Advertising Warranties and Guarantees are codified at 16 CFR Part 239 and give examples of disclosures that explain what a warranty covers.
facts.quote: (16 CFR Part 239) give examples of disclosures that explain what a warranty covers.

facts.fact: Deceptive warranty advertising violates the FTC Act, which prohibits unfair or deceptive acts or practices in commerce.
facts.quote: Deceptive warranty advertising violates the FTC Act, which prohibits unfair or deceptive acts or practices in commerce.

facts.fact: Under FTC guidance as summarized on the page, a 'satisfaction' or 'money back' guarantee counts as an offer of a full refund for any reason.
facts.quote: A “satisfaction” or “money back” guarantee counts as an offer of a full refund for any reason.

facts.fact: If a flooring ad advertises a 'lifetime' warranty, the advertiser has to make clear what 'lifetime' refers to.
facts.quote: If you advertise a “lifetime” warranty, you have to make clear what “lifetime” refers to.

facts.fact: For products covered by the Pre-Sale Availability Rule, the ad only needs to say that the warranty can be seen where the product is sold.
facts.quote: For products covered by the Pre-Sale Availability Rule, the ad only needs to say that the warranty can be seen where the product is sold.

facts.fact: For a flooring store, a lead usually means a sample request, a measure booking, a quote form or a click to call.
facts.quote: For a flooring store, that usually means a sample request, a measure booking, a quote form and a click to call.
